messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout v0.23 -> 10% traffic (commit abc123). Targets: api-inference-prod. Rolling out now.
incident-bot: HEALTHCHECK ALERT: canary group api-inference-prod-canary showing elevated 5xx (now 12.3% over 5m). Abort criteria met (threshold 5%). Paging oncall.
Sami N: I'm oncall — looking. seeing spike in 5xx across canary hosts. link: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/1769004321 :rotating_light:
Ajay K: logs show 502s originating from worker pool handling streaming /v1/stream responses. stacktrace truncated. sample:
```
2026-03-12T14:12:33Z ERROR handler.go:112 streamHandler: write: broken pipe
goroutine 345: ...
```
Rachel P: any customer impact so far? Ops dashboard shows ~20 requests failed across canary users. low volume but could be escalated if rollout continues.
Leo M: I recommend kill-switch (feature flag) for streaming-mux introduced in v0.23, speed test fails.
Sami N: Agreed. Initiating kill-switch for feature 'streaming-mux' now. Executing via FF console.
Sami N: Command I ran:
```
./ffctl set streaming-mux off --env=prod --scope=canary
```
Sami N: Response: feature 'streaming-mux' set to OFF for canary. Confirming...
Ajay K: Rolling out config confirm: canary hosts now 0% stream-mux. Re-checking logs.
incident-bot: EVENT: feature change detected for streaming-mux by Sami N
Sami N: 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% within 90s. still watching for residual errors. :thumbsup:
Rachel P: I'll notify support and customers on the pilot list. drafting message: "We paused a partial rollout due to elevated errors, no broad customer impact. We'll follow up." Want me to send now?
Leo M: Hold for 10m, let metrics stabilize then send a short update to pilot customers and sales-engineering.
Ajay K: Also going to roll the canary back to previous stable image (abc122) for safety. Running:
```
redwoodctl rollout cancel --deployment api-inference-prod --to-image=abc122
```
Ajay K: Cancel command returned OK, rollback initiated, expected convergence ~2m.
Sami N: Oncall handoff note: if errors resurge, abort full rollout and escalate to eng-sre. tagging @eng-sre
Rachel P: Copy. I'll update internal incident tracker INC-2026-032 and add timeline.
Sami N: Marking thread for follow-up. Current status: feature-flag OFF for canary, rollback in progress, customer impact minimal. Monitoring for 15m then close.
Leo M: I'll keep an eye on logs and add a postmortem template link: https://wiki/redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-032
Sami N: thanks all. moving to watch mode.
